answer: A sybil farm can mint a thousand free identities, but the harvest must voyage somewhere, and that is where the net tightens. Forge a thousand streams of loot into one sink, and at the dawn of each epoch settlement a steep convergence toll falls on the funnel. Evasion means keeping each puppet loot separate, locking real capital in a thousand tiny treasuries, or paying mixers hop by hop, so the attack bleeds margin either way. Honest agents trade diffuse peer flows and pass through untouched.
